readerCopy.body: A collective fear or hope becomes inseparable from the hidden power shaping the response. A crisis, spiritual movement, media campaign, or public grief gathers force while money, secrecy, and institutional interests determine which version reaches the audience. Neptune gives the moment emotional and symbolic meaning, while Pluto controls what remains buried and who benefits from the story. Under the conjunction, the vision and the power behind it become part of the same public reality. The response may feel deeply meaningful while making it unusually difficult to question who is directing the feeling and where it leads.
